es: Redactar recordatorios y reclamos firmes pero corteses con fórmulas de seguimiento y suavizadores escritos, evitar el tono seco y repasar el causativo have + objeto + participio.

teaching.en: A message that simply says «Reply today» can come across as curt, even when the writer is only in a hurry.
teaching.es: Un mensaje que solo dice «Responda hoy» puede parecer seco, aunque quien escribe solo tenga prisa.
teaching.explanationEs: Curt describe un tono demasiado breve y poco cortés. La solución no es quitar la petición, sino envolverla mejor.

teaching.audioText: A message that simply says «Reply today» can come across as curt, even when the writer is only in a hurry.

teaching.en: I am just following up on my request, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.
teaching.es: Solo quería dar seguimiento a mi solicitud, y le agradecería que pudiera enviarme amablemente una novedad antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Just y kindly suavizan el recordatorio; I would be grateful if you could + verbo + plazo pide con firmeza y cortesía.
segments: I am just following up on my request, and I would be
grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.
teaching.audioText: I am just following up on my request, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.

teaching.en: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.
teaching.es: Me temo que todavía no he recibido la pieza, y quisiera reiterar que la necesito a más tardar el lunes.
teaching.explanationEs: I am afraid suaviza la mala noticia; reiterate repite una petición sin repetir el reproche; no later than fija el límite.
segments: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I
would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.

teaching.en: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.
teaching.es: Por favor, responda en cuanto le sea posible y, en todo caso, a más tardar el lunes, ya que el plazo es firme.
teaching.explanationEs: At your earliest convenience es suave; in any case + fecha marca el límite que no se mueve.
segments: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case
no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.
teaching.audioText: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.

teaching.en: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday, as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.
teaching.es: Agradeceríamos que el coche estuviera reparado para el viernes, ya que una reparación rápida nos ayudaría mucho.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + objeto + participio pide que lo haga otra persona. Swift describe una respuesta o una solución rápida.
segments: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday,
as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.
teaching.audioText: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday, as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.

teaching.en: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must remain firm about Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.
teaching.es: Entiendo que el retraso no fue culpa suya, pero debo mantenerme firme con el viernes, y espero su respuesta.
teaching.explanationEs: Comprender y mantenerse firme van juntos: baja el tono, no el plazo. Look forward to va seguido de -ing.
segments: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must

teaching.audioText: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must remain firm about Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.

prompt.es: Elige la versión firme y cortés de este borrador brusco.

choices.text: I am sorry to bother you, but it does not matter if the part comes at some point, whenever you can manage it.
I would be grateful if you could send the part now, because I am tired of waiting and I may complain.
I am afraid I have not yet received the part, so I would be grateful if you could send it by Friday.

feedback.es: Esa versión da un hecho, pide con cortesía y fija un plazo; las otras renuncian al plazo o mantienen el reproche y la amenaza.

hint.es: Busca la opción que conserva el plazo pero quita el reproche y la amenaza.

origin.text: Blunt draft: «You still have not sent the part. Send it now. I am tired of waiting, and I will complain.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Agradeceríamos que el coche estuviera reparado para el viernes.»

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have it repaired) expresa que otra persona hace la reparación.

hint.es: Después del objeto it va el participio del verbo repair.

origin.text: The garage has already kept our car for a week. We would be grateful to have it ___ by Friday, as we need it for work.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Le agradecería que respondiera a más tardar el lunes.»

answer.text: I would be grateful if you could reply no later than Monday

feedback.es: I would be grateful if you could + verbo + no later than + día es la petición cortés con plazo.

hint.es: Empieza por la fórmula de gratitud y termina con el límite.

prompt.es: Según el correo, ¿qué parte del mensaje no se suaviza?

choices.text: The Monday deadline for the part, which stays fixed.
The request for a date, which is only a suggestion.
The hope that the writer is not a nuisance to the team.

feedback.es: Las fórmulas amables suavizan el tono, pero el remitente dice que debe mantenerse firme con el plazo del lunes.

origin.text: Dear Mr Lane, I hope you are well. I am just following up on my request of 4 March for a replacement part, and I am afraid I have not yet received an update. I understand that your team is busy, and I do not wish to be a nuisance, but I must remain firm about the deadline: the part is needed no later than Monday, as the machine is essential to my work. I would be grateful if you could kindly confirm the date.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con lo que consigue en el correo.

feedback.es: Kindly suaviza la petición; I am afraid presenta un hecho sin reproche; at your earliest convenience da margen; look forward to cierra con expectativa.

prompt.es: Completa: «Debo reiterar que la reparación tiene que estar lista el viernes.»

feedback.es: Reiterate repite una petición con firmeza y sin agresividad: es más formal y menos brusco que repeat.

origin.text: I understand that the workshop is busy, and I appreciate your help so far, but I must ___ that the repair has to be finished by Friday.

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué actitud transmite Mia con «I am afraid» y «I understand»?

choices.text: Ready to cancel the order and looking for an excuse.
Resigned to the delay and not wanting to insist further.
Annoyed, but hiding a threat behind polite words.
Firm about the date, but considerate towards the supplier.

feedback.es: Mia reconoce la dificultad del proveedor, pero pide adelantar la fecha y pide una respuesta pronta para buscar otra solución: firme y considerada.

origin.text: Dear Mr Ward, thank you for your quick reply. I am afraid the new delivery date of 20 June is too late for us. I would be grateful if you could bring it forward, and I understand that this may not be easy. If it is not possible, please tell me at your earliest convenience so that we can plan something else.

prompt.es: Completa: «Entiendo el retraso, pero debo mantenerme firme con la fecha.»

feedback.es: Remain firm es la colocación que combina comprensión con firmeza; firm es adjetivo y necesita un verbo copulativo.

origin.text: Thank you for explaining why the parcel is late. I understand the delay, but I must ___ firm about the date, because the event cannot be moved.

prompt.es: Reescribe con firmeza y cortesía: pide el pedido antes del lunes.

answer.text: I am afraid I have not yet received my order, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send it no later than Monday. I understand that your team is busy, but I must remain firm about the date. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
accepted: I am afraid I have not yet received my order, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send it no later than Monday. I understand that your team is busy, but I must remain firm about the date. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
Could you kindly send me my order before Monday? I am afraid it is already late, and I must remain firm about the date. I would appreciate an update, and I look forward to your reply.

feedback.es: Una buena reescritura mantiene el plazo del lunes, cambia la orden por una fórmula cortés y cierra esperando respuesta, sin insultos ni amenazas.

origin.text: Borrador brusco: «Your team is useless. Send my order now, or I will complain to your boss.» Reescríbelo en inglés con firmeza y cortesía: una fórmula de petición, un suavizador, el plazo (a más tardar el lunes) y un cierre que espere respuesta (de 35 a 60 palabras).

prompt.es: Lee el contexto. ¿Qué frase expresa lo que Carlos pide al taller?

choices.text: We would be grateful to check the brakes ourselves by Thursday.
We would be grateful to have checked the brakes by Thursday.
We would be grateful to have the brakes checked by Thursday.

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have the brakes checked) pide que otra persona haga el trabajo; las otras opciones dicen que lo haría el propio Carlos.

origin.text: Carlos cannot repair his own car, so he writes to the garage: the brakes have been making a noise for a week, and the car must be ready to drive on Friday. He wants the garage to do the work before then.

prompt.es: Lee la respuesta de la empresa. ¿Qué echa en falta la clienta?

choices.text: A firm date for when the part will be sent.
An apology for the delay in answering her.
A reason why the part has not arrived yet.

feedback.es: La empresa promete esfuerzo y «soon», pero no da ninguna fecha concreta: es lo que la clienta, que necesita un plazo, echa en falta.

origin.text: Dear Ms Hart, thank you for your patience. We are doing our best to find the part, and we hope to send it soon. Please be patient while we look into the matter, and do not hesitate to write again if you have any further questions.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me temo que aún no he recibido una respuesta.»

answer.text: I am afraid I have not yet received a reply

feedback.es: I am afraid + oración completa da la mala noticia como un hecho y no como un reproche.

prompt.es: Completa: «Su mensaje pareció seco, aunque usted no quisiera ser descortés.»

feedback.es: Curt describe un mensaje demasiado breve y seco; come across as indica la impresión que causa, no la intención.

origin.text: Your message was only two lines long, and it came across as ___ even though you did not mean to be rude.
